bondPriority.description: During battle, DMG dealt increases by 8%. This increases to 12% / 16% / 20%, if Crit Rate reaches 20% / 40% / 60%.
bondPriority.name: Toshiro Bond

boundaries.description: After using a technique or counterattack, the critical rate of the special attack increases by 30% for 6 seconds, and can be stacked up to 2 times. Each time a special attack lands a critical hit, the cooldown of the technique is reduced by 0.5 seconds. This activates once every 0.5 seconds.
boundaries.name: Sun That Seals the Sky

boundaries.description: Increases Getsuga Mark duration by 3 seconds. Each time Ichigo hits an enemy affected by Getsuga Mark, all damage dealt by him increases by 3% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. When Ichigo is in the Hollowfied state, can be stacked up to 10 times.
boundaries.name: Rising Black Moon

boundaries.description: Increases Level of Basic Attack, Technique, Ultimate and Counterattack by 2.
Increases Level of Basic Attack, Technique, Ultimate and Counterattack by 2.

skills.description: Ichigo strikes the enemy 5 times, dealing damage equal to 247%~???% of ATK and gaining spiritual pressure. If you stop the attack after the third strike, Ichigo will briefly charge up and then a glow will appear on his body. At that moment, press the basic attack button to unleash a special attack. Hollowfied: After becoming Hollowfied, Ichigo's ability greatly improves. The total damage of the basic attack increases to 367%~???%. The total damage of the special attack increases to 266%~???%. Special attack: Ichigo performs 6 continuous high-speed slashes, dealing damage equal to 179%~???% of ATK.
skills.name: Corte a alta velocidad

skills.description: Ichigo releases his spiritual pressure to attack from a distance toward the target, dealing damage equal to 232%~???% of ATK and applying one stack of Getsuga Mark for 5 seconds. When the technique hits the enemy, press the basic attack button and Ichigo will rush forward and immediately launch a special attack.
skills.name: Getsuga Tensho

skills.description: Ichigo unleashes the power of Hollowfication, immediately resets the technique's cooldown, and enters the Hollowfied state, which lasts for 10 seconds. In the Hollowfied state, Ichigo will instantly counterattack and gain the following effects: he is less likely to be interrupted by enemies, the damage he deals is greatly increased, he can unleash techniques twice in a row, his health will not fall below 1, and his Ultimate will be replaced by Black Getsuga Tensho.
skills.name: Hollowfication

ascend1: While Hollowfied, the counter button can be manually tapped to launch counterattacks
While Hollowfied, Ichigo's Crit Rate increases by 15%. Manually releasing counterattacks increases the Crit Rate Bonus to 25%
Increases Ultimate Energy Charge Rate by 20% and gains full Ultimate Energy upon the battle begins
For 20 seconds after Hollowfied state ends, Technique cooldown is reduced by 70%
ascend5: While Hollowfied, manual counterattacks enabled. Crit Rate +30%; manually releasing counterattacks: +50%
Ultimate Energy Charge Rate +40%, full Ultimate Energy at battle start
